title: Rinseless washing routine
summary: Work panel by panel on cool paint out of direct sun. Pre-treat heavier dirt, use generous solution and clean media, then dry with a soft towel. Use a conventional wash when contamination is too heavy for a safe rinseless method.

title: White perforated-seat care
summary: Wipe spills promptly with a soft cloth dampened with warm water and mild non-detergent soap. Avoid harsh chemicals and aggressive rubbing; do not saturate perforations.

title: Boot-opening precautions
summary: Check overhead and rear clearance before opening, especially in low garages. Configure a reduced powered-lift height when appropriate and keep people clear of the moving lid.

title: Driver-assistance behaviour and limits
summary: Driver assistance does not make the vehicle autonomous. Keep hands on the wheel, remain attentive, monitor surroundings and be ready to take over immediately. Availability and behaviour can vary with road, weather, markings and software.

title: Premium Connectivity timeline
summary: Trial ends 21 August 2026. The paid monthly subscription is due to begin on 22 August 2026. Recheck the Tesla app around the transition date.

title: Tesla app and notification behaviour
summary: Phone-key and notification behaviour depends on app permissions, Bluetooth, background activity and operating-system power management. Keep the Tesla app signed in and allow the permissions needed for the selected features.
